{"id":1830940399,"question_id":4054,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months, 1 week","timestamp":1763264754,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1830940399/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Count Distinct Integers After Removing Zeros","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    long long remove_zeros(string s)\n    {\n        string ans = \"\";\n        int num = 0;\n        for(auto ch : s){\n            if(ch == '0') continue;\n            ans.push_back(ch);\n        }\n        num = stoi(ans);\n        return num;\n    }\n    \n    long long countDistinct(long long n) {\n        set<long long>st;\n        for(int i=1 ; i<=n ; i++){\n            string num = to_string(i);\n            int ans = remove_zeros(num);\n\n            st.insert(ans);\n        }\n        return st.size();\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"count-distinct-integers-after-removing-zeros","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1127}
